info.name: Sumo Logic Span Analytics API
info.description:
# Getting Started
Welcome to the Sumo Logic API reference.

item.name: Get A Span Analytics Query Status

request.description: Get a status of a span analytics query with the given id. When the query has been completed, use the Span Query Result endpoint to get the result of the asynchronous query.

response.name: Details about the given span query.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the query to pause.

request.description: Pause a currently processed span search query with the given id.

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the query to resume.

request.description: Resume a previously paused span search query with the given id.

item.name: Get Results Of A Span Analytics Query

query.description: Limit of the number of spans returned in the response.

Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

request.description: Get a list of spans matching a query with the specified id. The response is paginated with a default limit of 100 spans per page.

item.name: Get Span Analytics Query Aggregated Results

request.description: Get span aggregation results for an aggregated span analytics query with the specified id. Only aggregated rows being part of the executed query will have matching results in the response of this endpoint.

response.name: The aggregation result of the executed query.

item.name: Run A Span Analytics Query Asynchronously

request.description: Execute a span analytics query and get the id to fetch its status and results. Use the Span Query Status endpoint to check a query status. When the query has been completed, use the Span Query Result endpoint to get the result of the asynchronous query.
